request.message:
Read and follow the developer_instructions in /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/roles/ui_researcher.toml as your specialized research role.

Use the complete ui-spec method at /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/method/ to investigate the consequential UI source and experience questions in /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/TASK.md and /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/INPUT.md. Read /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/RUN-CONTROL.md for evidence and environment conditions. Inspect the current app and relevant mature public products/implementations; search, genuinely observe, compare and refine the inquiry where evidence warrants. Return concise decision-useful sources, actual observed relationships, materially different candidates where useful, practical adoption paths and unresolved limits, with original tool outputs and real viewed captures retained under /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w07/evidence/research/. Do not change product code or make final product design decisions. Work only on this package and relevant public sources. Do not create further agents. Save a final research report and return its contents.

Please save the exact text of your delivered final research notification (including introductory delivery sentence and report body) to evidence/coordination/research-final-notification.md, clearly identified as a faithful export of your own final message. Do not rerun research or change product files. Return the saved path. This is for RUN-CONTROL's required final notification retention.

notification_export_followup.return_capture_note: Tool response exposed no payload. Later actual child final notification confirmed the saved path.

scope_outcome: Research only. No child product-code changes. Primary designer selected, implemented and inspected final product.
